decision_conditions: The details submitted pursuant to Conditions 10, 13 and 14 of planning permission ref. 25/01965/FUL fail to provide sufficient information to demonstrate compliance with the requirements of those conditions. In particular, insufficient information has been provided regarding the detailed design and construction of the oriel window, roof junctions, green roof and air source heat pump installation; the submitted Construction Management Plan omits essential information relating to construction standards, working hours and vehicle movements; and the Dust Management Plan fails to demonstrate an acceptable dust monitoring and mitigation strategy in accordance with current guidance. The Local Planning Authority is therefore not satisfied that the requirements of Conditions 10, 13 and 14 have been met or that the development can be implemented in a manner that would secure an acceptable standard of design and appropriately manage construction-related impacts. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D4 and T4 of the London Plan (2021), CP24 and CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and DMD37 and DMD47 and DMD49 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
